description: This file defines the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementModel class, which is a PHP model representing employee leave entitlement data within OrangeHRM's API. It includes properties, a constructor, and a method to serialize the model data into an array, mainly used for API output.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementModel
classes.description: A PHP model class representing employee leave entitlement details, implementing serialization for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an Employee object, an array of LeaveEntitlements, and an optional entitlement value.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the object properties into an associative array suitable for API output, calculating current entitlement based on leave entitlement type.
